scope: Independent static review of these four reference pairs only. This report does not establish that the full round is clean.

identity.png_hash_method: Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on the supplied unmodified PNG bytes.
identity.note: Run, round, binary, and source identity strings were checked in every case metadata JSON. The supplied reference bundle hash was recorded as assignment context; the archive itself was not read or rehashed.

comparison_basis.method: Each of the eight original PNGs was actually opened with tools.view_image. Geometry was compared in the common 930 by 1240 logical coordinate system; reference physical coordinates are divided by two. Coordinates in findings are approximate logical coordinates.

observations: The candidate retains six columns and three rows, with all 18 covers, book labels, unread badges, and applicable download indicators visible. Badges remain adjacent to their titles.
The continuation and daily update cards remain side by side, with a matching outer geometry and a clear continuation action.

Display headings use a serif face, interface labels use a sans-serif face, and secondary labels and progress tracks retain the reference grayscale hierarchy. Cover artwork differences were not treated as interface defects.
The centered 1/3 folio and next-page affordance sit above the 80-logical-pixel dock, and all five dock destinations are visible.
The category divider is visibly interrupted beneath inactive tab cells rather than continuing across the strip; see P3R1-REF17-4.
intentional_differences: Real catalog titles, cover artwork, progress, counts, capacity, and time may differ from sample content; geometry and hierarchy were still compared.
The first thumbnail's generic progress preview is not required to reproduce the real reading-progress value.

observations: The original candidate PNG shows a horizontally centered white queue panel, with no shadow or stippled scrim, an outlined pause-all button, and a black close button.

Three real queue records are visible on page 1/2, including one complete item, one active item, and one queued item. Each has a thumbnail, truncated title/chapter text, and a progress track. The right-hand counters or waiting label remain legible without overlapping the title.
Five total queue records and pagination are supported by the supplied state. The reference contains three sample rows; content-driven sheet height or top position is therefore not itself a finding.
The panel's two vertical borders terminate around logical y729, while the 1/2 folio and next-page affordance appear below them around y765. No enclosing bottom border is visible; see P3R1-REF17-1.
The sparse background library reflects the real one-book fixture and was not treated as a missing six-by-three library layout.
intentional_differences: Queue records and progress are produced by actual download workers against delayed loopback image responses.
The real fixture contains one library book, five queue records, and two queue pages instead of the reference sample catalog and three queue rows.
Fixture titles, chapter names, cover art, page counts, progress, time, battery state, and capacity differ from the sample. Content-driven panel height and top position are allowed.

observations: The white jump surface occupies the lower part of the library, keeps the folio and dock reachable visually, and presents the three real page buttons in one balanced row.
Page 1 has a black inverse fill and pages 2 and 3 have light outlined fills. Text is readable, and the remaining library content above the surface retains the reference six-column structure.
The black separator is drawn near logical y1017, crossing the top region of the page-button row, rather than at the top of the white surface near logical y946; see P3R1-REF17-2.
The selected 1/3 folio remains centered above the dock, with the next-page affordance visible on the right. Outside-dismissal behavior cannot be established from a still image.
intentional_differences: The candidate labels the surface 'Jump to page' using different Chinese wording; its meaning is retained.
Real cover artwork, titles, progress, counts, capacity, and time are allowed to differ from sample content.

observations: The white, black-bordered popup is anchored beneath the top-right actions at approximately logical x559/y113. Its width and three-row spacing agree with the reference, with no shadow or stippled backdrop.
The three context actions remain readable and available according to the supplied state. The continuation card and the underlying six-by-three grid retain their geometry.
The multi-select action uses an unboxed check mark, whereas the reference uses a checked square. Category management uses a list glyph, whereas the reference uses a folder outline; see P3R1-REF17-3.
The absence of the reference sample queue count is consistent with the candidate's actual empty queue. The library folio and all five dock items remain visible.
intentional_differences: The download action is labeled as download management and has no sample queue count because the actual queue is empty.
Real cover artwork, titles, progress, counts, capacity, and time are allowed to differ from sample content.

suggestions.description: Enclose queue pagination within a complete bordered panel.
suggestions.evidence: In the candidate, the side borders at approximately x145 and x784 end near y729, and no closing bottom border is visible. The queue 1/2 folio and next-page control sit below those ends near y765. The reference uses a complete closed rectangular sheet. This finding concerns the border and pagination container, not the allowed content-driven height or top position.
suggestions.recommendation: Size the white panel and its border to include the visible rows and the queue pagination, keep the folio and next-page control within the panel's padding, and draw a continuous closing bottom edge.

suggestions.description: Move the jump surface separator above its heading and page buttons.
suggestions.evidence: The white jump surface begins near logical y946 and the heading appears near y974, but the black full-width separator is near y1017, intersecting the upper part of the page buttons that start near y1014. The reference places the separator at the actual top of the surface, near logical y947, above both heading and buttons.
suggestions.recommendation: Anchor the separator to the top edge of the jump surface and preserve the existing heading and button spacing so no border crosses the page controls.

suggestions.description: Restore the reference's boxed selection and folder menu icons.
suggestions.evidence: The candidate popup shows only a check mark beside multi-select, omitting the square checkbox outline visible in the reference. The category-management row shows a bulleted list glyph instead of the reference's folder outline. The popup position, size, and text remain aligned.
suggestions.recommendation: Use the checked-square icon for multi-select and the folder-outline icon for category management, retaining the current icon bounds and row alignment.

suggestions.description: Keep the category strip's thin divider continuous beneath inactive tabs.
suggestions.evidence: Around logical y395, the candidate's thin gray category divider disappears under multiple inactive tab cells, producing white gaps such as approximately x136-203 and x233-294. The reference shows a continuous thin gray baseline beneath the category strip, with the active black underline drawn over it.
suggestions.recommendation: Draw the shared divider after the inactive tab backgrounds, or confine those backgrounds above the divider, while retaining the active underline and current tab geometry.

limitations: Static PNG inspection establishes visible geometry, text legibility, grayscale hierarchy, and visually exposed controls only. It does not verify tapping, outside dismissal, keyboard focus, pause/resume actions, or page navigation behavior.
No application, build, test suite, smoke test, runtime probe, or git command was run locally. Only the assigned JSON/PNG evidence was read and PNG hashes were computed.
The candidate PNGs are logical 1x captures and the reference PNGs are physical 2x captures. Inspection used normalized logical geometry; small rasterization differences were not treated as defects.
This report covers only reference-17. Findings may also occur in other cases, but those cases were not inspected by this reviewer.
